How membership works

Four steps, about five minutes. You can save and finish later.

  1. Verify your email

    We send a 6-digit code. No password to remember.

  2. Tell us about you

    Your address places you in your zone and Islamic Center.

  3. Choose a plan

    Single, family, or life membership. Pay securely by card or phone wallet.

  4. Get approved

    Track your application and see exactly what's needed to vote.
